reviews.title: Refund
reviews.text: I want to refund because I accidentally make a subscription but it can’t be refunded. What kind of apps is this that doesn’t want a refund. All you care is money how about your customer who needed the money. I want it back.

reviews.title: Ads make it unusable.
reviews.text: Used to love this app. Now I have to sit through like 3 minutes of AI generated ads to do anything. Unless you’re willing to pay, this app has become terrible.

reviews.title: on the fence
reviews.text: i use this app mainly for the AI enhancing feature. it can do an incredible job and i’m very satisfied with the results, however, you have to buy credits to use the AI features which is fair enough but more often than not, it pops up saying “this image can’t be enhanced right now, please try later” and it STILL takes your credits even though it’s failed to enhance your image. the credits aren’t cheap either and this is extremely frustrating and for this reason i’m rating this app 2 stars.

reviews.title: Bbbbaaaaadddd!🤬😡🥵
reviews.text: I got this app thinking that for my holiday I could spark up all my photos and add board to all of them but I was wrong. It’s a total fake. It doesn’t help in anyway and it’s starting to make me hate this app. I’m really surprised about this and I’m never gonna download it again.

reviews.title: 越來越不好用
reviews.text: 原本很喜歡這個軟體 後來浮水標開始要看廣告 原本很基礎的模板也不見 多了很多要收費又不常用到的模板 索性卸載。

reviews.title: Slamming liars
reviews.text: Wish I could leave a 0 start rating. The 3 day free trial offer is a scam. It will ignore the 3 day free trial and charge you instantly upon purchasing it. If you use this app don’t buy any subscription unless you actually plan to pay.

reviews.title: From 105% great app to some straight trash!
reviews.text: Super upset about this. I’m not typically one to leave reviews, especially bad ones but this used to be an absolute wonderful app, been using it for 9 years at least! I used to refer my friends to use this app. Because, you could get some really good quality edits with its many many tools to retouch and enhance photos or even create collages and many templates to choose from. The options were endless and FREE! The only catch was you gotta watch an ad before you could save your final product. And sometimes the app crashed. Over the years (last 2-3 especially) it’s been so demanding. More ads. Some you can’t even escape from. Gotta close the app and opening it again. Not to mention the price! I gotta say it’s ridiculous. Yes, the option to spend money for access to more option and styles of wall paper background or finer detailed tools. That was understandable but now it’s like they don’t even give you choice you HAVE TO spend money. I just wasting an hour of my day trying to edit one photo just for them to trap me in a never ending mobile game ad.
